user.title: House & heat source
user.description: Thermocast starts in observe mode: it only forecasts until you enable control.

data_description.release_entity: Entity that allows/blocks space heating. Recommended: the RC310 summer threshold (number) of EMS-ESP with 16 = allowed, 10 = blocked – if Home Assistant fails, the controller resumes heating by itself once it gets cold. A summer/winter select also works but stays blocked if HA fails.
data_description.heating_active_entity: Heating circuit pump running (e.g. EMS-ESP heating pump) – better than burner state, because the screed keeps receiving heat during burner pauses. Recommended.

reconfigure.title: Change house & heat source
reconfigure.description: Zones and learned models are kept. If you change the release entity while control is on, the old one is set to 'heating allowed' first.

data_description.release_entity: Entity that allows/blocks space heating. abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Thermocast house is supported.

data_description.surfaces: YAML list, e.g. [{kind: window, azimuth: 90, tilt: 90}, {kind: roof, azimuth: 180, tilt: 40}]. Azimuth: 0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W.
data_description.leads_release: If on, this zone's comfort decides when the boiler may heat.
data_description.valve_entity: Radiators only. Best: the TRV's own thermostat (climate) – its heating/idle state is used. A sensor with the real valve opening in % also works. Not a configured limit like valve_opening_degree.
data_description.gain_entities: Power sensors (W), presence or on/off entities that add heat.
data_description.neighbor_sensors: Temperatures of adjacent rooms (heat exchange is learned).
data_description.comfort_schedule: A schedule helper (e.g. weekdays 8–17 for the office). When set, it replaces 'Comfort from/until'.
data_description.comfort_high: A heating block may warm the zone up to here, so the boiler can run long and pause long. Default: comfort + 1 K.
data_description.base_temp: Lowest temperature outside the comfort time (night, office closed). Default: comfort − 2 K.
data_description.bt_control: Thermocast sets the target of this room's Better Thermostat: upper bound during a block, otherwise the lower bound. Disable Better Thermostat schedules/automations for this room.
data_description.bt_entity: The climate entity of Better Thermostat (not the TRV itself).
data_description.quiet_from: No thermostat changes (valve noise) during the quiet time; 15 min before it starts the target is set to the base temperature.
data_description.quiet_schedule: A schedule helper for more quiet windows, e.g. nap 12:30–14:30 and night 19–07, also per weekday. Quiet when this schedule OR the from/until window is on.

error.invalid_surfaces: Invalid surface list (kind window/roof/wall, azimuth 0–360, tilt 0–90).
error.valve_only_radiator: A valve entity only makes sense for radiators.
error.invalid_bounds: Base temperature must be ≤ comfort − band and the upper bound above comfort.
error.quiet_incomplete: Set both start and end of the quiet time (or neither).

data_description.forgetting_factor: 0.996 ≈ 10 days memory. Lower adapts faster but is noisier.
data_description.confidence_z: Planner uses mean − z·σ of the forecast. Higher = more cautious.
data_description.dhw_active_entity: Hot water charging runs the boiler pump with a hot flow: these times do not count as space heating (model, history, warm start) and are shaded in the timeline. Recommended for combi boilers.
data_description.burner_starts_entity: Total counter (state class total_increasing), e.g. EMS-ESP burner starts. Used for KPIs.
data_description.heat_energy_entity: Total heating energy (kWh, total_increasing), e.g. EMS-ESP energy heating. Used for kWh per heating degree day.
data_description.calibrate_sigma: Widens σ per forecast horizon so that ±σ covers ~68 % of the forecast errors observed in the last 14 days (needs ≥ 48 checks per horizon; never narrows it).
data_description.starts_weight: 0 = short blocks, little gas; 100 = few long blocks that charge the rooms up to their upper bound.

release_not_confirmed.title: Thermocast: heating release not confirmed
release_not_confirmed.description: {entity} did not take the value Thermocast wrote. Thermocast retries with increasing pauses (at most 40 writes per day) to protect the controller's EEPROM. Check the EMS-ESP gateway and the entity.

release_write_budget.title: Thermocast: daily write limit reached
release_write_budget.description: Thermocast stopped writing to {entity} for today (40 writes) to protect the controller's EEPROM. The heating keeps its last state; check why the value does not stick.

failsafe.title: Thermocast: fail-safe active
failsafe.description: Thermocast keeps heating allowed because: {reason}. It recovers automatically once the cause is gone.
